description: A PostHog experiment holdout: a stable slice of users excluded from every experiment that references the holdout, used to measure the combined effect of experiments.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the holdout belongs to.

Name.description: Human-readable name of the holdout group.

Description.description: What the holdout reserves and why.

Filters.description: Non-empty JSON array of release condition groups defining the held-out population (use Fn::ToJsonString), in the same shape as feature flag release conditions. Each group's `rollout_percentage` (0-100) is the share of users held back; `properties` optionally narrows the group. Don't set `variant`: PostHog sets it to holdout-<id>. Only the first group's rollout_percentage is embedded in linked experiments' flags.

UpdatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update.
